author: pi-agent

patch.value: Self-referential release-context test freezes the package version the release bump mutates

The in-process CLI coverage test 'all-release context resolves real repository tags and package version' asserted options.version against the frozen literal '2026.8.7'. That value is read from this repo's own package.json via --release-version-from-package, but the daily release workflow runs 'npm version <next>' (the 'Update release version' step) BEFORE the 'Run release checks' step that runs 'npm test'. On release day the resolved version is the not-yet-tagged next version, so the assertion compares it against a stale literal and fails. The defect is structural: a test pinned to a mutable fact about the very checkout the release mutates makes the release that mutates it fail. Net effect: pm-changelog cannot release again until the assertion stops freezing the version.

The named assertion compares options.version to the version read from this repo's package.json at runtime, not to a literal, so it passes at both the committed version and a bumped untagged version; A regression test encodes the release-time condition against a temporary git repo fixture: a package version with no matching git tag still resolves to the package version and resolves no release tag; No other test in test/ asserts against this repo's live package.json or manifest.json version or its newest git tag; npm run check, npm test, npm run coverage, npm run docstring, and npm run changelog:check all pass with coverage at 100/100/100 and thresholds unchanged

cp -a <repo> /tmp/pmc-repro && cd /tmp/pmc-repro; npm version 2026.8.9 --no-git-tag-version --allow-same-version; node scripts/sync-version.ts 2026.8.9; npm test  # the named test fails with '2026.8.9' vs '2026.8.7'
A release that bumps package.json before running npm test passes the test suite at the bumped, not-yet-tagged version.
The scheduled release run 2026-08-08T04:27Z failed at 'Run release checks' because options.version resolved to the bumped version while the test asserted the stale literal '2026.8.7'.
